title: A gym's plan moves down to Starter at night with no line in any log
what: When a gym bought the cheaper plan while a dearer one was still paid for, the nightly billing job switches it to Starter and deletes the waiting change. No row is written to the HQ log or anywhere the owner or HQ can open; the only trace is a count in the Worker's own log. HQ cannot tell when or why a gym's plan changed.
expected: Each automatic plan change writes one line (gym, old plan, new plan, when, why) that HQ's log and the gym page show.
who: HQ and gym owners who buy online
how_often: each planned switch, once online buying is on
fix_line: Write a log line for every plan the nightly job switches

title: Plan-end reminders are noted as made though none is sent, and nobody can see the note
what: Each night the billing job notes a 7, 3 and 1 day plan-end reminder per gym, but the message part sends nothing. Nothing reads the note, and HQ shows neither the reminders nor 'not sent: not built'. Because each note is made once, the day messages are built, gyms already noted would never get theirs.
expected: HQ shows which reminders were due and that they were not sent and why; a reminder is noted only once it really went.
how_often: every night once online buying is on
fix_line: Show due reminders and their not-sent reason in HQ, and mark a reminder only when sent

title: The nightly deletion of old AI Assistant requests leaves no line in the HQ log
what: The privacy promise to delete AI Assistant requests after 400 days runs every night, but unlike the other clean-up parts (old logs, test gyms) it writes no row to the HQ log; how many were deleted lives only in the Worker's own log, kept a short time. HQ cannot show that the promise is being kept.
expected: The deletion writes its counts into the HQ log like the rest of the nightly clean-up.
fix_line: Write one HQ log row with the deleted counts

title: When the weekly free-limit check fails or is not set up, HQ keeps showing the old result
what: The Monday check stores its result only when it works. If Cloudflare refuses, cannot be reached, answers oddly, or the settings are missing, nothing is stored: the System page keeps last week's 'fine' (or nothing) with no word that this week's check did not run.
expected: A failed or skipped check is stored with its reason and shown on the System page and in Needs you.
fix_line: Store the failure reason too and show it on HQ
